cross_vertical_insight: Across these verticals, the shared pain point is the need for efficient management and categorization of various appointments and events that tie into broader project or client management processes. These verticals span freelance and small business environments where automating the organization of calendar events can save significant time and reduce errors. Key buying triggers include handling multiple types of recurring events and needing visibility into categorized schedules.
